credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Frontal half length portrait of O'Keeffe sitting on a white cushion against an adobe wall  (in the Abiquiu house?), her fair is pulled back from her face, she looks towards the camera with a neutral expression, hands are folded in her lap; she wears one of her black wrap dresses, a white v-neck shirt or dress, her Alexander Calder pin, and her favorite Taxco  black suede / sterling silver belt.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
